_about: Every word the page shows. The core names a key; the page looks it up here.
title: Raiders of the Lost Mart
tagline: Ride out in the van, fill the client's order, carry out what you find, and build your guns from it.
credit: A fan-made game from a friend's design. The art is drawn in TikZ; the sound is made in your browser.
no_webgl: This game needs WebGL 2, which this browser does not offer.
join_hint: Type the five-letter room code the host sees.
join_paste: No code working? Join by pasted invitation
join_paste_hint: Paste the host's invitation, make your reply, and send it back to them.
join_reply_hint: Send this reply to the host.
ws_hint: Six slots, one part in each. Basic parts never run out; anything else you own comes off your shelf while it is on the gun, and is lost if you do not make it back to the van.
effect_goo: Goo: slows drones and eats their armour, no damage
effect_shock: Shock: stalls drones and jumps to the next one
board_hint: Six orders, one mall. Each one parks the van in front of a different door; the queen's at the end of Main Street.
lobby_paste_hint: Make an invitation, send it, and paste the reply you get back.
online_hosting: Waiting for raiders. Share the room code or the link.
online_waiting: In the lobby. The host starts the run.
online_full: That room is full or already riding out.
online_version: You and the host have different versions of the game. Both of you reload the page (Ctrl+Shift+R, or Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac), then try again.
online_no_relay: Could not reach the public relays. Try joining by pasted invitation.
online_no_path: Your two networks will not connect directly. Try another network.
online_error: Something went wrong with the connection.
online_bad_room: That is not a room code.
online_bad_code: That code is not an invitation or a reply.
paused_hint: Online, the run goes on while this is open.
hud_downed_hint: Crawl toward cover. A teammate can bring you back by holding E.
use_revive: Hold E to bring them back
use_generator: Hold E to start the generator
use_doors: Hold E to open the doors
use_leave: Hold E to drive off (everyone outside is left behind)
toast_doors: In the back of the van. Hold E to open the doors.
toast_out: The mall is out there. Find the order; the van waits here.
toast_leaving: The van is leaving. Get in.
toast_left: A raider has left the run.
r_text_success: You came back with the order. The client paid in parts.
r_text_back: You came back, but the order was not filled. You keep what you carried.
r_text_lost: You did not make it back. The parts on your gun and in your pack are gone.
r_text_aborted: The host left, so the run ended. Nothing was lost.
help_rows: look (click the view to capture the mouse)
reload (from the rounds in your pack)
crouch: quieter and harder to see
open doors, search, pick up, revive, start things, leave in the van
help_text: Every gun is built from six parts. The barrels you see on screen are where the shots come from. Shoot drones in their glowing cyan weak spots; grey armour soaks up most of a hit. Every drone has parts you can tear off: rotors, armour plates, guns, legs, wings. A drone changes when it loses them: shoot its guns off and a wasp or warden rams you and a hornet runs; shoot a rotor off and a flyer sags and drifts; take a strider's legs and it limps, then plants itself as a turret. Goo eats armour. Whatever you carry back to the van is yours. Drones do not see you at once: a meter fills over a drone that is noticing you, a ? means it is coming to look, a ! means it has you. Crouch, stay out of their sight, and keep quiet to slip past.
drone_wasp_about: Fast. Circles you and fires in bursts. Battery on its back.
drone_moth_about: Unarmed. Spots you, calls the others, and flies out where you can see it to draw you out of cover toward waiting wasps.
drone_hornet_about: Sniper. Hides, peeks out somewhere new, and charges a red laser. Break the ring round its lens.
drone_warden_about: Heavy. Keeps its armour toward you. The core is underneath; the four rotor pods can be shot off.
drone_tick_about: Small spider. Runs at you and blows up. Its weak spot is underneath.
drone_strider_about: Big spider. Keeps its distance, fires bursts, stomps when you are close. Weak spot under its tail.
goal_cudi: Find the vintage Kid Cudi tee in the Hot Topic display case and carry it to the van. {have}/{need}
goal_foodcourt: Clear the drone nest in the food court. {left} left.
goal_drives: Recover the camera drives and carry them to the van. {have}/{need}
goal_hive: Break the hive in the west department store: pods first, then the core. Hive {hp}
goal_power: Start the generator in the centre court and hold the court until it is running.
goal_done: Done. Get back to the van and drive off.
mission_cudi_brief: Vintage Kid Cudi tee, Man on the Moon tour, size L. A scout saw it in the display case at the back of the Hot Topic, two-thirds of the way down the west side. Bring it back clean.
mission_foodcourt_brief: The food court has become a nest. There is a viewing next week. Every drone in the food court comes down.
mission_drives_brief: The mall's camera drives: one in the security office at the north end, one in the electronics store at the south end, one under the jeweller's counter. All three.
mission_hive_brief: Something is building in the west department store and the drones keep coming from it. Shoot out the glowing pods, then the core.
mission_power_brief: They want the mall lit for a shoot. Start the generator by the dry fountain in the centre court and keep the drones off it for a minute while it spins up.
entrance_north: Van parks north, facing the north department store doors.
entrance_south: Van parks south, facing the south department store doors.
entrance_west: Van parks west, facing the west department store doors.
entrance_east: Van parks east, facing the food court doors.
entrance_southeast: Van parks east of Main Street, facing the head of the street.
part_pistol_about: Quick and light. One shot a click.
part_smg_about: Fast and automatic, each shot lighter.
part_pump_about: Slow, hard-hitting, one shot a click.
part_heavy_about: A huge magazine. Slows you down.
part_rifle_about: Long, accurate, and goes through one drone.
part_rocket_about: A slow rocket that bursts on impact.
part_stack_about: Two barrels, one above the other.
part_square_about: Four barrels in a square. Four times the shots, four times the ammo.
part_gatling_about: Six barrels firing in turn. Spins up first.
part_blast_about: Each shot bursts where it lands.
part_goo_about: No damage. Slows drones and eats their armour.
part_shock_about: Stalls drones; the shock jumps to the next one.
part_ember_about: Less damage, but drones keep burning.
part_scope_about: Long zoom, very tight when aiming.
part_scanner_about: Marks drones' weak spots near you.
online_no_host: No host found with that code yet. Check the code with the host, and make sure everyone has reloaded the page recently so you all have the same version. It keeps looking.
gear_cap_about: Keeps the sun off. Does nothing else.
gear_helmet_about: Takes 12% off every hit, and 10 more health.
gear_headset_about: Shows how aware every drone near you is, even through walls, and they notice you a little slower.
gear_pads_about: 15 more health, and melee hits 10% harder.
gear_brace_about: The gun kicks 40% less, and melee hits 20% harder.
gear_vest_about: 35 more health and 10% off every hit, but a little slower.
gear_mesh_about: Health grows back further (to 95) and two and a half times as fast.
gear_poncho_about: Drones take nearly twice as long to notice you, and your steps are quieter.
gear_trench_about: Four more pack slots and 8% off every hit.
gear_hazmat_about: Blasts do 60% less to you, and goo cannot slow you.
gear_quickgloves_about: Reload a third faster and search twice as fast.
gear_medgloves_about: Bring a downed teammate back in less than half the time, and with 70 health.
gear_kneepads_about: Move crouched almost at a walk, and crouch while sprinting to slide.
gear_runners_about: 8% faster, and X rolls out of the way (shots miss you mid-roll).
gear_sockshoes_about: Silent footsteps: drones cannot hear you walk or run.
gear_boots_about: 10 more health and blasts do 40% less, but a little slower.
gear_mines_about: G drops a proximity mine (3 a run). It arms after a second and blows when a drone comes near.
gear_decoys_about: G throws a beeper (4 a run). Drones that hear it go to look.
gear_paint_about: G paints a strip ahead (2 a run). Raiders run 40% faster on it; drones on it are slowed by half.
gear_smoke_about: G throws a smoke pellet (3 a run). Drones cannot see through the cloud.
gear_bat_about: F swings. Quick, quiet, and good for knocking parts off.
gear_sledge_about: F swings. Slow, but it tears rotors and legs off.
gear_machete_about: F swings. The fastest swing, lighter hits.
item_about: What the client wants. Carry it to the van.
ws_gear_hint: What you wear. Basic pieces are free; anything else comes off your shelf while it is worn and is lost if you do not make it back.
inv_hint: The run goes on while this is open. Hover anything to read it; drop what you do not want.
toast_no_ammo: Out of ammo. Search for rounds, or use your melee (F).
ws_bring: Your gun takes {ammo}. You start the run with {n}: the shelf is always topped up to enough for three or four drones.
ws_trade_hint: Pick an ammunition above, then trade a spare piece of gear for {ammo}. Rarer pieces buy more. Worn and basic pieces cannot be traded.
ws_trade_none: No spare gear on the shelf. Bring some back from a run.
drone_queen_about: A walking mech as tall as the buildings on Main Street. Stamps on anyone under her, fires rocket salvos from her shoulder pods, launches wasps from her back and shoots with the cannon under her brow. Shoot out her knees to slow her, her pods and cannon to quiet her, the plate under her belly to bare her core. Her back vent glows too.
goal_queen: Bring down the queen on Main Street. Queen {hp}
mission_queen_brief: Something the size of a building walks Main Street at night. Knees, pods and the cannon come off; the plate under her belly hides her core. We left rounds behind your van. Bring her down.
entrance_street: Van parks past the north end of Main Street, where she walks.
